basis: Owner direction and attached place-mastery synthesis, September 15, 2026.
learningStatement: Learn how three households share a goods route, recover a missing commission, and reconnect the neighborhood.

channelLow.refillPolicy: reject while a character occupies the otherwise flooded channel

archOpen.meaning: opened from the far side, available permanently after reload

nodes.label: Leonardo's workshop
nodes.information: See the destination, the far landing and the initially locked return connection.

nodes.label: Workshop arch, familiar side
nodes.information: Learn this end before finding its back.

nodes.label: Canal court
nodes.landmark: canal bend beneath the hoist silhouette
nodes.information: Observe the households and choose an approach.

nodes.label: Precision workshop
nodes.landmark: working escapement beside the loading door
nodes.information: Ask for help and learn the missing commission's goods route.

nodes.label: Loading court
nodes.information: Direct cooperation enables legitimate goods-stair access.

nodes.label: Dye household
nodes.landmark: drying frames and visible dye equipment
nodes.information: Infer a working upper route from the household's purpose.

nodes.label: Working dye loft
nodes.information: Read the goods route before committing to it.

nodes.label: Drying roof
nodes.information: See the gallery and a descent to the loading court.

nodes.label: Dry sluice landing
nodes.information: See how lowering water opens the service channel.

nodes.label: Service channel
nodes.information: Use the lowered channel; no swimming is assumed.

nodes.label: Maintenance cellar
nodes.information: Understand the shared mechanism and identify a dry way up.

nodes.label: Hoist gallery
nodes.information: Reach and retrieve the authorized parcel by any valid approach.

nodes.label: Return landing, workshop arch back
nodes.landmark: same bell bracket, seen from behind
nodes.information: Recognize the workshop and open the latch from this side.

nodes.label: Quiet courtyard
nodes.information: Pause and choose another nearby approach.

edges.authoringRequirement: A stepped refuge exits to dry controls; flooded depth restricts entry, never emergency egress. Real geometry and depth handling are still required.

approaches.tradeoff: authored cooperation rather than speed or payment
more elevation changes and route reading

approaches.advantage: infrastructure knowledge and a service approach

behavioral.request: explain or assist with drying work
behavioral.recovery: available at either work location; opportunity recurs

behavioral.request: cooperate with a legitimate delivery to enable goods stairs

presentation.transitionPolicy: open the other face before closing the last open face

evidenceLimits: Logical graph and authored intent only. Connectivity is not capsule clearance, native rendering, performance, fun, a finished level or a published feature.
